generic_domain.justification: The term 'Artificial Intelligence' is the broadest category among the given options as it encompasses all other domains listed. It covers the entire spectrum of AI research, including but not limited to machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, robotics, computer vision, and ethical considerations related to AI. All specific areas like 'Ethical AI', 'Neural Networks', or 'Reinforcement Learning' fall under the umbrella of Artificial Intelligence.
